_doc: Valency/behavior classes for verbs the 2026-08-01 review showed the generator mishandles. Generation v2 must branch its sentence template on class. Verbs not listed are 'plain' (normal personal subject).

remove.tranquilar: not a Spanish verb — replace with tranquilizarse (or calmar)

impersonal.haber: existential/auxiliary only; never a personal subject; invariable 3s in existential use (hay/había/hubo/habrá/habría/haya/hubiera + noun). Drill it as auxiliary (perfect tenses) or existential, never 'yo he/había' + noun-quantity.

dative_experiencer.pattern: IO clitic + verb agreeing with the THING: 'a mí me gustaba el mar', 'les preocupará la noticia'. Never conjugate for the experiencer as subject.

eventive_third_person.pattern: events as subject, usually 3s/3p: 'ocurrió algo extraño', 'eso sucede a veces'. Never 'tú sucederías'.

reflexive_preferred.casar: marry = casarse (se casó); non-reflexive casar means to officiate/marry someone off and needs an object
reflexive_preferred.acordar: remember = acordarse de; plain acordar = to agree (different meaning)
reflexive_preferred.despedir: say goodbye = despedirse de; plain despedir = to fire someone
reflexive_preferred.enterar: find out = enterarse de; plain enterar is rare
reflexive_preferred.quedar: quedarse = stay; quedar = remain/meet — pick one meaning per exercise
reflexive_preferred.casarse_note: when drilling these, put the clitic in respuesta and its own grupo

defective.soler: only presente (suelo) and imperfecto (solía) are idiomatic; NO futuro/condicional/preterite drills
defective.nacer: biographical punctual verb — presente-habitual drills of one's own birth are nonsensical; use preterite or 3rd-person generic (los bebés nacen...)
